programme.desc: The Werewolf Transformation: Sheldon's well-organised world is turned upside down when he learns that the barber who has cut his hair for years is ill in hospital.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Homer vs the Eighteenth Amendment: When alcohol is banned in Springfield, Moe's Tavern becomes a speakeasy and Homer reinvents himself as the Beer Baron.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Grade School Confidential: Principal Skinner and Mrs Krabappel embark on a torrid affair but have to bribe Bart to keep the whole thing a secret.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: Dangerous Curves: Homer and Marge head to a log cabin for the weekend and reminisce about their early courtship.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: The Monkey Suit: Ned is horrified by an evolution exhibition and asks Reverend Lovejoy to promote creationism. So Lisa arranges secret evolution classes...

programme.title: First Dates
programme.desc: Beauty queen bricklayer Chloe seeks a girl with grand designs for the future. India wants a tall, dark, handsome guy. And financial investigator Sylthea gives her date a grilling.

programme.title: New: Celebs Go Dating
programme.desc: Brand new series: Kerry takes Paolo home... for a grilling! Louis dishes out some honest truths. Donna opens up to the agents. Can Mark hit the bullseye with new date Josie?

programme.title: Gogglebox
programme.desc: Britain's sharpest armchair critics watch This Morning, Strictly Come Dancing, The Undoing, The Yorkshire Vet, First Dates, and BBC News on Trump vs Biden.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: An organic bakery in the newly restored Larkton's Mill causes resentment in Lower Blissingham, with many of the old village businesses struggling, traffic having increased and rumours that owners Tom and Chrissie Larkton are planning to expand. Highwayman Inn landlady Denise Bantrig organises a protest group against the couple, and is supported by Maria, who runs the old village cafe and will not let her business go down without a fight. Their complaints are not taken too seriously until several people are dosed with a dangerous hallucinogenic at a Midsummer's Eve party, with Barnaby and Winter called in to investigate, and the situation escalates when a farmer is murdered. Crime drama, starring Neil Dudgeon and Nick Hendrix

programme.title: Hands of a Stranger
programme.desc: 1962. Horror. Director: Newt Arnold. Stars Paul Lukather, Joan Harvey & James Noah. After losing his hands in an accident, a concert pianist is given a hand transplant with deadly consequences.

programme.title: Element of Doubt
programme.desc: 1996. Thriller. Directed by Christopher Morahan. Stars Nigel Havers, Gina McKee & Judy Parfitt. A woman has doubts about the loyalty of her husband and suspects him of playing a deceitful game.

programme.title: The Ebb Tide
programme.desc: 1997. Adventure. Director: Nicholas Renton. Stars Robbie Coltrane & Chris Barnes. Three hapless adventurers agree to sail a ship to Australia with a secret cargo, but soon enough disaster strikes.

programme.title: Murder at the Grange
programme.desc: 1952. Drama. Directed by Victor M. Gover. Starring Tod Slaughter & Patrick Barr. A private investigator is approached by two old ladies who say they are being terrorised.

programme.title: Look At Life Shape of a Ship
programme.desc: 1960. A look at the huge new liners being built, the life of cargo carrying ships and the exciting future of air freight. With a look at the liner the Canberra.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: The Buntline Special. 1955. Stars Hugh O'Brian, Lloyd Corrigan & Douglas Fowley. A brash visitor arrives in Wichita and attempts to convince Wyatt to join a Wild West show.

programme.title: Marked Men
programme.desc: 1940. Crime. Director: Sam Newfield. Stars Warren Hull, Isabel Jewell & Paul Bryar. A young medical-school graduate escapes prison and finds a small haven in Arizona until gangsters show up.

programme.title: The Dark Eyes of London
programme.desc: 1939. Horror. Directed by Walter Summers. Stars Bela Lugosi & Hugh Williams. A series of drownings in the Thames starts Inspector Holt on the trail of one of London's most sinister murderers.

programme.title: Stolen Face
programme.desc: 1952. Drama. Directed by Terence Fisher. Stars Paul Henreid & Lizabeth Scott. A doctor makes a female convict look like the pianist who left him, but can she really be the woman he loves?

programme.title: The Gambler and the Lady
programme.desc: 1952. Crime. Directed by Patrick Jenkins & Sam Newfield. Stars Dane Clark, Kathleen Byron & Naomi Chance. A gambler attempts to put his past behind him to impress a wealthy girl he has fallen for.

programme.title: Lydia
